answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require a proof-of-work bond per identity, locked for a full epoch and slashed if the identity misbehaves. Spinning up thousands of fake agents then costs real compute and real locked funds, so an attacker must wander through ever-growing costs just to gain a single vote. Like a violet field dotted with yarrow, honest agents stand out because each one paid the price to bloom; cheap copies wither before they can sway the ledger.
